title: Fix this note, fix this progression
problem: The Watch line (round 1) names the note a drill keeps missing, but a warning alone doesn't change the habit. The owner, after round 1: "Research Molly Gebrian's method of repetition to reinforce the correct muscle memory. It should be a 'fix this note' or 'fix this progression' mode." (2026-11-21)

evidence.quote_or_summary: Gebrian, Learn Faster, Perform Better (OUP 2024), Appendix A, ch. 4 Microbreaks: three correct repetitions, a 10-second break, three more; if any had errors, start over.
Gebrian: take breaks within the repetitions, not just do them over and over; she aims for three times in a row without mistakes.
Bönstrup et al. 2019, Current Biology: early skill gains came during short rests between practice periods, not during practice.

hypothesis: If the Watch line opens a short fix for its note, or for the two-note progression into it, run as Gebrian's microbreaks (3 clean, 10-second break, 3 clean, a miss restarts the set), the note lands in tune in the next day's drills more often than with the warning alone.
acceptance_criteria: From the Watch line, 'Fix this note' runs repetitions of the flagged note alone; 'Fix this progression' runs the note before it in the drill, then the flagged note.
A repetition is clean when the target's first steady pitch is within the medal tolerance and no wrong note was heard; the app waits for the bow to stop between repetitions.
Three clean in a row fill a set; a miss empties the current set; after set 1 a 10-second break with a countdown, during which nothing is scored; after set 2 the fix is done.
Three misses in a row also give a 10-second break.
Fix repetitions are logged apart from the note history, so the Watch line still judges the note from real runs; the line says how many fixes were done today.
success_signal: On flagged notes, more first-landing hits in the next day's drills after a fix than before it, in the practice log.
strongest_reason_not_to_build: A miss the microphone hears wrongly also empties the set, so a noisy room or a borderline tolerance can turn the fix into a loop that builds tension, not the habit.
